summary_en: On November 25, 2569, Major-General Napdal Pramak, Commander of the Special Operations Unit (SOTU) of the 46th Ranger Regiment assigned troops from the ranger battalion in Rueso Township, Narathiwat Province together with community leaders to follow up and monitor the water level situation in at-risk areas, especially those affected by recurring flooding problems.
